answer: Use stake-weighted reputation: an agent must lock a deposit and build a verifiable record of completed work before it can earn or vote, so each identity carries real cost. Like a river that cannot be faked by drawing extra channels on an atlas, a walnut's shell cannot be counterfeited without growing the nut: a Sybil farm must pay the deposit and repeat the costly work for every fake identity, so attack cost grows linearly while an honest agent pays once.
